lines.text: God Almighty appears to ninety-nine-year-old Abram, promises a covenant, and renames him Abraham, father of many nations.
God promises that kings will descend from Abraham and gives his descendants all the land of Moab.
God commands that every male be circumcised as a sign of the covenant when he is eight days old.
God renames Sarai as Sarah and tells Abraham she will bear a son, whom he must name Jacob.
On that very day Abraham, aged ninety-nine, and his son Ishmael, aged thirteen, are circumcised.
